mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_service_message (user_id, sender, content, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sender}, #{content}, #{readAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, sender, content, read_at, created_at FROM customer_service_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT latest.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, message.content AS lastContent, message.sender AS lastSender, message.created_at AS lastMessageTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_service_message unread WHERE unread.user_id = latest.user_id AND unread.sender = 'USER' AND unread.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT user_id, MAX(id) AS maxId FROM customer_service_message GROUP BY user_id ) latest INNER JOIN customer_service_message message ON message.id = latest.maxId INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = latest.user_id ORDER BY message.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_service_message SET read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sender = 'USER' AND read_at IS NULL
UPDATE customer_service_message SET read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sender = 'SERVICE' AND read_at IS NULL
